methods.fedavg: Flower sample-count-weighted mean of submitted parameters
methods.clip_fedavg: delta_i = submitted_i - global; full-model float64 L2 norm; tau = unweighted median of submitted norms each round; factor_i = min(1, tau/norm_i), with factor=1 for zero norm; Flower sample-weighted mean of global + factor_i * delta_i
methods.coordinate_median: global + unweighted coordinate-wise median of submitted deltas; each logical identity is one vote; no clipping or sample weighting

missing_asr: blank/null for model poisoning; not measured
